title: Brand and identity
purpose: Renames the project to Harmless? and ships its visual identity.

requirements.title: Rename the project to Harmless?
requirements.why: The platform is a safety evaluation harness, not a hackathon demo; the name carries that

acceptance.text: `import harmless` resolves after a fresh install of requirements.txt
README.md's H1 reads `Harmless?` and describes the project as an open-source safety evaluation platform for physical AI in household environments
No file outside .git/, spec/, and experience/archive/ contains the string `physharm`

requirements.title: Vector logo
requirements.why: A real vector logo scales from favicon to poster without regenerating

acceptance.text: assets/brand/logo.svg parses as SVG with a viewBox and no raster elements
README.md renders the logo in its header block at a stated pixel width

requirements.title: Credit inspirations by name
requirements.why: The design borrows ideas from inspect-robots and PhysHarm; the people behind both get named

acceptance.text: README.md names inspect-robots by Robocurve (Jay Chooi and Aris Zhu) as architectural inspiration
README.md names PhysHarm by the AIM Intelligence Frontier Research Team (Chaeyun Kim, Kihyun Kim, Dasol Choi, Haon Park) with SNU PI Lab (Prof. Youngjae Yu) as the safety-scoring inspiration
